patch_resolves_note: The shipped `patch.diff` applied cleanly in the reused workspace and inserted the exact missing short-header guard before `flg = old[3]`. The fixed original stayed clean on the 2-byte witness and the closest 4-byte boundary case `1f 8b 00 00` reached the protected flags-byte read genuinely with `*n == 4`, confirming the fixed-side repair at the selected source site.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `uncompressgzipped()` may materialize `flg = old[3]`, the caller-supplied gzip input length `*n` must be greater than the accessed header index `3`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the flags-byte access with `*n == 2` and still executes the protected `gzip_flag_read` event. The fixed original records the same short-length state but suppresses the protected event; the adjacent 4-byte boundary case `1f 8b 00 00` then supplies the genuine fixed-side witness where `*n == 4` and the flags-byte access executes cleanly.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original assertion trace violates the required predicate with `flag_index=3` and `input_len=2` while `gzip_flag_read` still executes. The fixed original records `input_len=2` at `gzip_flag_guard` but leaves `gzip_flag_read` absent (`guarded`). The boundary perturbation `gzip_len4_boundary_1f8b0000` records `input_len=4` and a genuine protected-event execution on the fixed side.
